s: Glidden Max-Flex Exterior Fabric paint can be used to paint fabric and rugs, but first, you need to make sure there are no coatings that could keep the spray paint from adhering to the surface. You can test this by dripping a small amount of water on the carpet or fabric. If it forms beads, then there is probably a stain-resistant coating.
